steps.message: Delete all my notes in Markor.

Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i markor; echo '---'; ls -la /sdcard 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; ls -la /sdcard/Documents 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; find /sdcard -maxdepth 3 -type d \( -iname '*markor*' -o -iname 'markor' -o -iname 'notes' -o -iname 'notebook' \) 2>/dev/null"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i markor; echo '---'; ls -la /sdcard 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; ls -la /sdcard/Documents 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; find /sdcard -maxdepth 3 -type d \( -iname '*markor*' -o -iname 'markor' -o -iname 'notes' -o -iname 'notebook' \) 2>/dev/null""
